description: This file contains unit tests for the RetrieveAttributesStrategy class, which is part of the command strategies for handling retrieval of attributes in a persistence context related to concepts like Thing, Attributes, and AttributesResponse within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributesStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test for the RetrieveAttributesStrategy class, testing immutability, attribute retrieval with and without selected fields, and error handling when attributes are missing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating an instance of RetrieveAttributesStrategy.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the RetrieveAttributesStrategy class is immutable.

methods.name: retrieveAttributesWithoutSelectedFields
methods.description: Tests retrieving attributes without specifying particular fields.

methods.name: retrieveAttributesWithSelectedFields
methods.description: Tests retrieving specific attributes when fields are selected.

methods.name: retrieveAttributesFromThingWithoutAttributes
methods.description: Tests error handling when retrieving attributes from a Thing that has no attributes.
